findings.title: Transcript search is non-functional
findings.evidence: Code searches lecture.full_transcript field which does not exist on Lecture entities. Transcripts are stored as separate Transcript entities in the database (see database/firestore-schema.md, backend/src/services/processingService.js line 179, and all other frontend pages use base44.entities.Transcript.filter()).
findings.consequence: Users cannot find lectures by transcript content despite UI advertising this capability. Search will never match transcript text, breaking a core requirement.
findings.correction: Load Transcript entities at mount using base44.entities.Transcript.filter({}, 'timestamp', 2000), build a map of lecture_id to concatenated transcript text, then search that map instead of the non-existent lecture.full_transcript field.
